sessions.short: playbook §C arc A "Sleep Descent". Alpha entry (10 Hz), short hold,
sessions.long: Technique: playbook §C arc A "Sleep Descent". Alpha entry (10 Hz), short hold, then a continuous slope-limited glide 10->2 Hz at ~0.44 Hz/min, then a simultaneous Soft Off of light + audio at ~2 Hz. NO wake-up. Goal: fall asleep. Mirrors sleep architecture: alpha -> theta -> delta. Bands: alpha 10 Hz (hold 2 min) -> glide 10->2 Hz (18 min, ~0.44 Hz/min) -> delta ~2 Hz soft-off. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving or operating machinery. This is an experiential relaxation aid, not a medical device. Flicker stays <=10 Hz the whole session (never enters the 15-25 Hz photosensitive danger band); warm amber only (no saturated-red strobe, no blue alternation); brightness capped <=30%; LED brightness ramps IN over 10 s and fades to 0 (never an abrupt cut); the delta core sits in the SAFER <3 Hz zone. Format: LED line = time freq duty bright R G B mask Audio = A time freq pan volume mod channel freq_r wave_type Binaural beat is encoded by holding a FIXED freq_r=250 and ramping the LEFT carrier `frequency` (freq_r is NOT interpolatable). Perceived beat = 250 - frequency: car

sessions.title: Power Nap
sessions.short: NASA-style restorative nap. Drop-in 10 Hz -> delta ~3.4 Hz over ~16 min, brief
sessions.long: Goal: NASA-style restorative nap. Drop-in 10 Hz -> delta ~3.4 Hz over ~16 min, brief floor/hold, then a deliberate re-ascent 3.4 -> 7 -> 12 Hz to wake before sleep inertia sets in. Ends bright and awake — NO fade-out (this is the sanctioned power-nap wake exception, see guidelines §4). Bands: alpha 10 -> delta 3.4 (rest) -> theta 7 -> SMR/low-beta 12; audio beat finishes 14 Hz. Safety (§4): LED flicker CAPPED at 12 Hz — the final 12->14 Hz wake is AUDIO-ONLY (LED held at 12 Hz). Never enters the 15–25 Hz danger band. Brightness capped 50%; LED ramps in over 10 s (0->25%) and fades off over 2 min (4:00->6:00), no abrupt edges. Warm amber (255,100,0) descending -> off during rest -> amber->warm white (255,200,120) on wake. No saturated-red strobe, no red/blue alternation. Audio peaks 65/100. Encoding (§5a): freq_R is NOT interpolatable, so the binaural beat is slid by ramping the LEFT carrier `frequency` with freq_R held FIXED at 255 Hz. Perceived beat = 255 − carrier. Nap goes down then up, so the carrier rises (descent) then falls (re-ascent): beat 10=245, 9.5=245.5, 4=251, 3.9=251.1, 3.4=251.6, 7=248, 12=243, 14=241. sessions.title: Deep Relaxation / Stress Melt
sessions.short: decompress a keyed-up, stressed user to a theta "melt", then return to calm-alert alpha (relaxed, not groggy).
sessions.long: Goal: decompress a keyed-up, stressed user to a theta "melt", then return to calm-alert alpha (relaxed, not groggy). Driver: AUDIO isochronic (modulation) — the entrainment beat is carried by ch1 audio; LED is a dim cool->warm wash. SAFETY (guidelines §4): the 14 Hz start is adjacent to the 15-25 Hz photosensitive band, so the LED does NOT flicker (frequency 0 = steady light) until the beat has descended to <=10 Hz at t=5:00. Brightness capped at 30%, ramps IN over 15 s and fades OUT over 30 s; LED flicker is only ever 6-10 Hz; no red strobe, no flicker-rate color alt. Ramp convention (§5a animate-on-start): the '>' prefix sits on the EARLIER entry and its value is the ramp START; the target is the next same-channel entry's value, swept across the gap. (Putting '>' on the last/later entry never fires.) LED: mask 15 (all 4 legacy zones), duty 50%. Audio: ch1, carrier 200 Hz, pan 0 (center), sine wave, no binaural.

Driver: TWO binaural channels, freq_r FIXED at 260 Hz on both (freq_r NOT interpolatable). ch1 (panned left -30): carrier 250->254 => beat 10->6.0 Hz. ch2 (panned right +30): carrier 250->253.7 => beat 10->6.3 Hz (the deepening offset). sessions.short: playbook §C arc D "Focus/SMR". Hold 14 Hz SMR (calm focus). The 14 Hz
sessions.long: Technique: playbook §C arc D "Focus/SMR". Hold 14 Hz SMR (calm focus). The 14 Hz beat is delivered ENTIRELY BY AUDIO isochronic modulation; the light is STEADY (never flickers) and DIM. End bright/alert. Bands: induction ~10 Hz (alpha) -> deepen -> HOLD 14 Hz SMR -> exit toward 12 Hz, end ALERT. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving. Experiential, not medical. 14 Hz sits at the lower edge of the 15-25 Hz photosensitive flicker danger band, so the beat is carried 100% by AUDIO isochronic `modulation` and the LED `frequency` is held at 0 Hz (STEADY illumination) for the ENTIRE session — it NEVER pulses at the beat rate. A steady (non-pulsed) lamp cannot photically drive or trigger seizures. Working brightness is capped DIM at <=25% (playbook photosensitivity guidance); it ramps up over 15 s (never abrupt) and is never cut to 0 (a focus session ends ALERT — the light stays on and brightens to ~40% to signal "come back"). Audio volume capped at 60/100. (Optional enhancement: a short 40 Hz audio-only gamma burst mid-session — omitted here to keep a single clean SMR target;

sessions.short: short, reliable "panic-button" alpha preset. Gentle binaural driver; light is calming
sessions.long: Goal: short, reliable "panic-button" alpha preset. Gentle binaural driver; light is calming ambient only (NOT a driver). Effects often felt within 10-15 min. Bands: alpha ~10 Hz emphasis, brief 12 Hz settle. Binaural for anxiety g~=0.45 [E]. Duration: 1,500,000 ms (~25 min). Audio ch1 binaural; LED mask 15 (four zones), steady. SAFETY (guidelines 4): NO visual flicker — LED held steady (freq 0), dim blue only, brightness <=28% with a slow breathing LFO floored at 12% (never full black<->white), ramps in/out >=10 s. Binaural carrier 370->372 Hz (<1000), L/R offset = beat <=12 Hz (<35). No red, no strobe. Technique (guidelines 5a): freq_r is NOT interpolatable -> hold freq_r = 382 FIXED and ramp the carrier frequency 370 -> 372 Hz, so beat = freq_r - frequency slides 12 -> 10 Hz smoothly. Ramp convention = animate-on-start: '>' lives on the EARLIER entry (its value = start); the target is the next same-channel entry's value, swept over the gap.

sessions.long: Goal: hold the wake-sleep border for hypnagogic imagery WITHOUT falling asleep. Bands: induction alpha 10 Hz; descent 10->6.5 Hz; twilight bottom 6.5 Hz (theta); imagery hold oscillates 8<->12 Hz (centered on the 10 Hz imagery peak). Driver: ISOCHRONIC (audio `mod` = beat Hz, the preferred theta driver; 200 Hz carrier, sine). Light flicker + audio pulse locked 1:1 at the same Hz throughout. Drift method: LFO. The imagery hold uses a sine LFO on BOTH the LED freq and the audio mod (`~8:12:75000` = sine 8<->12 Hz, 75 s/cycle). The format applies one LFO per field (verified: MOD_LED_FREQ + MOD_AUDIO_MOD dispatch in config_parser.c), so this single slow sine simultaneously provides the 8<->12 imagery-band oscillation AND the never-static "floating frequency" (Lucia) anti-sleep drift. A separate breathing brightness LFO (~20:30:10000) adds texture. LED: cool white (200 220 255) drives imagery (white entrains; color is cortical); violet-blue (90 40 200) for the theta

sessions.long: Goal: open / non-dual "choiceless awareness". The design intent is STABILITY and SPACIOUSNESS, not stimulation — a steady low theta-alpha border with minimal change. sessions.long: Goal: a shamanic "drum journey": a monotonous theta drum carries the listener down into a lower/upper-world journey, then a faster "callback" rhythm brings them back. Scaffolding for the practice, not a guarantee of any state. Basis: monotonous drumming at ~4-4.5 Hz (theta) is the classic driver of the "shamanic state of consciousness". Melinda Maxfield found a steady ~4.5 Hz drum held for >=15 min reliably shifts practitioners into theta trance (vivid imagery, time distortion); recent work links theta neural tracking to drumming-induced altered states. Hence the ~4.5 Hz journey hold. Driver: ISOCHRONIC (the sharp, monotonous drum) via audio modulation = the pulse Hz; the pulse slides by ramping mod directly (mod IS interpolatable, per guidelines 5a). Light flicker runs 1:1 with the drum pulse. LED: dim warm amber square flicker tracking the drum 1:1 (all <=10 Hz, safe), gentle breathing brightness LFO, four zones (mask 15). sessions.long: Technique: playbook §C arc C "Alpha + Breath". Hold a relaxed 10 Hz alpha with a 0.1 Hz (6 breaths/min) breathing LFO on brightness for resonance/coherence pacing, then a gentle up-ramp to 12 Hz + brighten to emerge alert. Bands: alpha 10 Hz hold (with 0.1 Hz brightness breath) -> lift 10->12 Hz, brighten, end alert. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving. Experiential, not medical. Every rate <=12 Hz (below the 15-25 Hz photosensitive band); binaural carrier 240 Hz (<1000), beat <=12 Hz (<35); brightness capped <=40% with a floor; light ramps in 15 s and fades out over the final 30 s (both >=10 s); calm teal color (no red). Breath LFO note: the 0.1 Hz swell here is a SYMMETRIC 10 s sine (`~15:35:10000`). A true asymmetric 4 s-in / 6 s-out pace needs a firmware LFO shape (out of scope); symmetric coherence pacing ships now. Driver: binaural, freq_r FIXED at 250 Hz (NOT interpolatable). sessions.short: the 07_genus_40hz protocol delivered for COMFORT via a v2 invisible-flicker
sessions.long: Technique: the 07_genus_40hz protocol delivered for COMFORT via a v2 invisible-flicker (flicker-free spectral flicker, playbook B1) pair. Two complementary-colour banks run 40 Hz in ANTIPHASE (amber phase 0 / blue phase 180) at matched dim brightness, so the mean luminance stays ~flat (little visible flicker) while the retina still receives the 40 Hz oscillation. Audio 40 Hz / 4% click, dim. Bands: fixed 40 Hz gamma (light antiphase pair + audio click), steady 30 min, fade. EXPERIMENTAL: the 40 Hz amyloid claim is CONTESTED; the entrainment is well established. The "invisible flicker" comfort effect depends on the two colour banks being on PHYSICALLY INTERLEAVED pixels (see channel_map recipe) and on an RGB backend; on a brightness-only (direct) backend or non-interleaved strip it degrades to two dim 40 Hz zones — still safe (40 Hz is above the danger band), just less "invisible". channel_map recipe (menuconfig CONFIG_LED_CHANNEL_MAP): channels are fixed by temperature/eye (ch0=L-cool bit1, ch1=L-warm bit2, ch2=R-cool bit4, ch3=R-warm bit8). Engine caveat: this build's AM depth is fixed (~0.1), so the swell is gentle, not the "deep depth" of the reference — a deeper burst awaits the firmware trapezoid/depth work. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving. Experiential, not medical. sessions.title: Split
sessions.short: playbook B5 "independent split-field / per-eye". The two eyes are driven at
sessions.long: Technique: playbook B5 "independent split-field / per-eye". The two eyes are driven at DIFFERENT flicker rates via different channel masks: LEFT eye 16 Hz (a beta 'alertness-within-the-dream' cue) and RIGHT eye 6 Hz (theta / dream). Via the optic-chiasm crossover this biases the two hemispheres differently. After a 10 Hz alpha induction on BOTH eyes, the field splits, holds, then soft-offs to dark (lucid sessions never wake you). Bands: induction alpha 10 Hz (both) -> split LEFT 16 Hz / RIGHT 6 Hz -> soft off. channel_map recipe (menuconfig CONFIG_LED_CHANNEL_MAP): channels are fixed by temperature/eye (ch0=L-cool bit1, ch1=L-warm bit2, ch2=R-cool bit4, ch3=R-warm bit8). The LEFT eye = mask 3 (both L temps, ch0+ch1), the RIGHT eye = mask 12 (both R temps, ch2+ch3), and both eyes = mask 15. Map LEFT-eye pixels to channels 0/1 and RIGHT-eye pixels to channels 2/3. For glasses with one pixel per eye: "0,2". For 4 pixels per eye on an 8-pixel strip: "0,1,0,1,2,3,2,3". The masked LED lines then drive each eye independently. sessions.title: Eyes
sessions.short: playbook B7 "Ganzfeld: red bias, diffusion, ramps". A STEADY, uniform, warm
sessions.long: Technique: playbook B7 "Ganzfeld: red bias, diffusion, ramps". A STEADY, uniform, warm amber-red field viewed EYES CLOSED. The eyelid passes ~14.5% at 700 nm but <=3% below 580 nm, so amber/red (>=620 nm) is the wavelength that actually reaches the closed-eye retina. Homogeneous, unstructured stimulation (no flicker) plus steady pink-noise 'shhh' induces the Ganzfeld effect — drifting imagery and deep relaxation. A gentle 7 Hz theta binaural underlays it. This is the STEADY FIELD complement to the cool-white FLICKER variant 15_ganzflicker_imagery.ledc. Bands: no visual flicker (steady field); 7 Hz theta binaural underlay; long stable hold. SAFETY / CONTRAINDICATIONS: Do NOT use if you have photosensitive epilepsy, a seizure disorder, or a history of photic migraine. Do not use while driving. Experiential, not medical. The field is STEADY (freq 0, NO flicker) — the "no saturated-red strobe" rule concerns FLICKERING red; a steady red field is safe. Brightness capped <=25%, eased IN over 15 s (>=10 s rule) and faded out over 2 min. A hardware diffuser in front of the LEDs makes the field more uniform (recommended for the true Ganzfeld effect). sessions.short: the Monroe "Focus 10" mind-awake / body-asleep threshold used as a launch point
sessions.long: ALTERED STATE: the Monroe "Focus 10" mind-awake / body-asleep threshold used as a launch point for out-of-body and expanded-awareness experiences. Scaffolding for the practice, not a guarantee of any state. Arc: alpha 10 induction -> glide to theta 4 Hz (Focus-10) -> deep multi-carrier hold (16 min) -> gentle return to alpha. V2 FEATURES USED (and why): * SEPTON multi-carrier STACK (Monroe US 5,356,368) — the 4 Hz theta beat is delivered by THREE stacked binaural pairs (200/204, 208/212, plus the primary 265->271 / 275) sharing one 4 Hz delta-f. This produces cross-ear binaural AND within-ear monaural beats at once: a richer, more robust FFR than a single pair (playbook A5, monroe_patents_guide.md 4b). * EEG-CONTOUR carrier, wave 7 (Monroe US 5,213,562) — one layer uses the non-sinusoidal EEG-contour carrier shape ("neither sinusoidal, nor square, nor triangular"), 250/254 => a 4 Hz beat from the L/R detune. The patent claims the contour itself aids entrainment (monroe_patents_guide.md 4c). * TRAPEZOID isochronic pulse, audio env=3 + duty + attack — a crisp 4 Hz body-buzz drum (137 Hz, 40% duty, 5 ms click-safe edge) adds a felt isochronic pulse to the smooth beats (playbook A2). *

sessions.long: ALTERED STATE: the "shamanic state of consciousness" — a deep theta drum-trance for inner journeying, driven by a monotonous ~4.5 Hz drum.
